description: Source code for a Google Cloud Speech-to-Text V2 streaming service implementation within the Pipecat project. It includes class definitions, methods for managing streaming recognition, configuration, and response processing, with focus on real-time speech recognition features and handling Google Cloud API interactions.

classes.name: GoogleSTTService
classes.description: Implementation of a streaming speech-to-text service using Google Cloud's Speech-to-Text V2 API, supporting real-time recognition, configuration updates, and automatic reconnection to handle streaming limits.

methods.name: language_to_google_stt_language
methods.description: Maps a Language enum to the corresponding Google Speech-to-Text language code.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleSTTService with credentials, location, sample rate, and parameters.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates whether the service supports metrics generation (returns True).

methods.name: language_to_service_language
methods.description: Converts Language enum(s) to Google STT language code(s).

methods.name: _reconnect_if_needed
methods.description: Reconnects the streaming recognition if currently active.

methods.name: update_options
methods.description: Dynamically updates recognition options and reconnects stream if needed.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Initializes the streaming recognition configuration and starts the audio stream.

methods.name: _request_generator
methods.description: Generates streaming requests for the recognition API, handling streaming limits.

methods.name: _stream_audio
methods.description: Handles bi-directional streaming with Google Cloud Speech API, managing reconnections.

methods.name: run_stt
methods.description: Processes audio chunks for transcription, queues audio data for streaming.

methods.name: _handle_transcription
methods.description: Handles transcription results (placeholder, no implementation shown).

methods.name: _process_responses
methods.description: Processes streaming recognition responses, manages final and interim results, and handles stream aborts.
